title: The Long Orchard
author: Mara Vane
blurb: Petra Sandoval, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
